# TestScript for 01-minimal-hello
# Asserts defaults, flag overrides, short flags, and --help

# 1. Default greeting
exec minimal-hello
stdout 'Hello, World!'

# 2. Flag override
exec minimal-hello --name Alice
stdout 'Hello, Alice!'

# 3. Short flag and boolean flag
exec minimal-hello -n Bob -l
stdout 'HELLO, BOB!'

# 4. Help screen
exec minimal-hello --help
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'minimal-hello \[flags\]'
stdout 'Minimal single-command hello world CLI'
stdout '-n, --name'
stdout '-l, --loud'
